newsitem.title: UK: U.S. gasoline dump forces weaker IPE gas oil close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. gasoline dump forces weaker IPE gas oil close.

text.p: IPE oil futures slumped on Thursday as speculators sold August gasoline in the U.S. ahead of the contract's expiry and signs grew Iraq's aid handout plan would be approved by the United Nations, traders said.

IPE September gas oil last traded at $169.25 a tonne, down $1.75 on the day, while front-month IPE Brent was changing hands at $18.63, 34 cents down, giving up most of Wednesday's gain in a sharp afternoon fall.
"It was absolutely the U.S. gasoline and the fact that the U.N. and Iraq are going to shake hands next week," said one broker.
